zh: 数据库升级不再需要 DBA：基座更新应用时会自动在应用库执行 db/upgrade.sql（只建缺少的表，不动已有数据）。诊断台的建表检查也覆盖了团队版表，缺表时提示重新上传最新安装包即可补齐。
en: Database upgrades no longer need a DBA: the platform runs db/upgrade.sql in the app schema on every update (creating only missing tables, leaving data untouched). The diagnostics schema check now covers team tables and, if any are missing, says to re-upload the latest package.
